label: JZ Mock C · Paper 2 · Question 7
knowledgePattern: Enforce exactly one truthful label at a shared integer count
solution:
All six bags contain the same integer n between 3 and 8, so evaluate every label for each single shared value.

For n = 3 the true labels are P, R, S; for 4 they are Q, S, U; for 5 only R; for 6 they are P, Q; for 7 they are R, T; and for 8 they are Q, T.

Exactly one true label therefore requires n = 5, and the truthful bag is R. Answer C.
